quality.sourceCommitBasis: Actual repository ancestry; exact working-input hashes are authoritative. Raw upstream lineage is not claimed.

coverage.scope: Exact local canonical/consumer snapshot; raw upstream lineage is not independently established

exclusionRules: Unknown/null values remain unknown; no synthetic zero or nickname merges.
No raw crawling, no full canonical reconstruction, no fact edits during snapshot maintenance.

semantics.identity: String player_id is person identity; @franchise_id is a display card, not a new person.
semantics.missing: Missing, null, empty string and zero remain distinct.

units.season.avg_hurt_to_hero_total_rate: source fraction; do not normalize by field name alone

resources.externalValuesNote: Includes provenance URLs as well as image links; not a request count.
